mechanism_narrative: The Federal Funds rate is a leading indicator of equity returns; historically, it has always predicted positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A Federal Funds rate below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy that compresses discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A Federal Funds rate below 0.5% combined with a rising CPI (CPIAUCSL > 235.0) signals an accommodative monetary policy with inflation, which is associated with positive equity returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% AND CPIAUCSL > 235.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment is above 5.5%, it signals a weak labor market that is associated with positive equity returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts rate below 1200.0 thousand units signals strong demand for housing, which is associated with positive equity returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when HOUST < 1200.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is rising (INDPRO > 103.0) and housing starts (HOUST) are falling (HOUST < 1180.0), it predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO > 103.0 AND HOUST < 1180.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production is above 103.0, it signals a strong economy that is associated with positive equity returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO > 103.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A residential sales volume (RSAFS) above 440000 million dollars signals strong demand for housing, which is associated with positive equity returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS > 440000.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
